overview.lead: Global capability building and startup acceleration, from Silicon Valley
paragraphs: Headquartered in Silicon Valley, Odyssey Ventures, LLC was founded in 2018 as a specialist in capability-building education for global markets and startup acceleration. We design and run hands-on education programs for public institutions, startups and universities, along with acceleration programs that help startups expand globally, providing practical and structured solutions for entering overseas markets and strengthening global competitiveness.

Odyssey Ventures launched its startup acceleration business in earnest in 2024. Building on our founder's and team's years of experience mentoring and growing startups, and on our wide network across Silicon Valley, we run both partner programs and our own programs.

facts.label: Business
facts.value: Startup acceleration, corporate education and consulting

items: Founded GlobalLeadersCamp, LLC (San Jose, CA), starting as a corporate leadership consulting company
Renamed to Odyssey Ventures, LLC and launched the startup acceleration business in earnest
Ran the Global Product Academy (Design Thinking, Product Management, Program Management)
Planned and ran the Hanyang University global meetup program
Ran the KIC DC Tech Frontier_Startup Talk & Mixer program
Ran the KIRO robot startup global meetup program
Ran the Silicon Valley Accelerator Around-X Program & K-Global Program Networking Event
Planned and ran the Mobility Matters business meetup
Delivered the 2025 KSC Silicon Valley onlanding program brokerage service
Recruiting the first cohort of the 2026 Odyssey U.S. Expansion Support Program

aboutPage.expertsDescription: Odyssey Ventures brings together experts with deep hands-on experience in product design, product management, program management and marketing in Silicon Valley.
aboutPage.teamDescription: Our programs are run by Silicon Valley instructors with deep academic and field expertise, together with partners who bring years of startup mentoring and consulting experience built on successful business and startup careers in global markets.

consultingPage.title: From your first U.S. sale to your VC round, we see it through
consultingPage.description: Our top-tier advisory board and Odyssey Ventures' hands-on Silicon Valley know-how take you all the way from sales to venture funding.
consultingPage.whyDescription: Not a report that sits on a shelf. We work with you until the results are in.

why.title: A top-tier advisory board
why.text: More than 100 partners in law, accounting, marketing and investment, plus experts from leading tech companies, matched to your specific challenge.

why.title: Proven Odyssey know-how
why.text: Experience founding a NASDAQ-listed startup, leading product at global tech companies and years of startup acceleration, applied directly to your business.

why.title: All the way to sales
why.text: We find potential U.S. customers, set up the meetings and design pilots and PoCs to land your first revenue in the market.

why.title: All the way to VC funding
why.text: We sharpen your IR deck and pitch, then connect you with Silicon Valley VCs and support you through the round.

process.title: Diagnose
process.text: Assess your product, market and team, and set clear goals for the U.S.

process.title: Strategize
process.text: Build your go-to-market, sales and fundraising strategy.

process.title: Execute
process.text: Match advisors to your needs and set up customer and investor meetings.

process.title: Deliver
process.text: Stay with you closely through contracts and closing your round.

consultingPage.contactDescription: Tell us where you are with U.S. expansion, sales or fundraising, and the Odyssey Ventures team will get back to you directly.
